components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact brick primary action with complete hover and keyboard focus states.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #d35c46; border-radius: 8px; background: #d35c46; color: #0c1119; font: 500 13px/1.25 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .05); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #c95440; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d35c46; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:active { box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Ghost Toolbar Button
components.description: Quiet icon-forward action for dense toolbars and composer controls.
components.html: <button class="ds-button-ghost" aria-label="Voice control"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M12 2a3 3 0 0 0-3 3v7a3 3 0 0 0 6 0V5a3 3 0 0 0-3-3Z"/><path d="M19 10v2a7 7 0 0 1-14 0v-2M12 19v3"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-button-ghost { width: 32px; height: 32px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #8995a6; } .ds-button-ghost:hover { background: #1f2835; color: #e7ecf3; } .ds-button-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d35c46; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-ghost:active { background: #161d28; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Compact tonal field with a restrained brick focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 240px; height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #1f2835; border-radius: 10px; background: #1f2835; color: #e7ecf3; font: 400 14px/1.45 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: rgb(137 149 166 / .32); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #d35c46; outline: 3px solid rgb(211 92 70 / .18); outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Active Navigation Row
components.description: Familiar settings-sidebar row with icon, label, and tonal active state.
components.css: .ds-nav-row { width: 220px; min-height: 36px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #1f2835; color: #e7ecf3; font: 500 13px/1.25 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; } .ds-nav-row:hover { background: #293545; } .ds-nav-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d35c46; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Compact semantic state label; color is reserved for real status.
components.css: .ds-badge-success { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 18px; padding: 0 5px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgb(16 185 129 / .16); color: #6ee7b7; font: 500 12px/1 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: shuv2code is a compact operator workspace used while code, agents, terminals, and previews are all in motion. Quiet midnight navy or warm paper working surfaces carry the interface, with scarce brick red reserved for identity, focus, selection, links, and primary action. Familiar controls and stable placement build trust faster than explanatory copy or invented interaction patterns.
keyCharacteristics: Warm brick accent below roughly ten percent of the working area
Tonal depth with restrained borders and shadows
Familiar navigation and controls with complete keyboard and touch behavior
DM Sans for product UI and JetBrains Mono for code-shaped content

rules.name: The Ten Percent Rule
rules.body: Brick stays below roughly ten percent of a working surface. Its rarity makes selection and action legible.

rules.name: The One Sans Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce display typography into product UI. Hierarchy comes from weight, size, spacing, and placement.

rules.name: The Tonal First Rule
rules.body: Choose the correct adjacent surface token before adding shadow. If the surface only works with a large shadow, its hierarchy is wrong.

dos: Do preserve the existing information architecture, density, spacing, and control alignment when restoring a lost capability.
Do use brick only for identity, focus, selection, links, and primary action.
Do use existing sidebar, button, input, badge, and composer patterns before creating a new affordance.
donts: Don't use generic AI dashboard spectacle: oversized gradients, glowing empty space, or decorative agent metaphors that compete with the work.
Don't allow upstream identity leakage: T3 Code names, assets, routes, or language must not appear as shuv2code product identity.
Don't ship hidden capability: direct routes, orphaned components, and undiscoverable gestures are not acceptable entry points.
